_template._comment: Template for data-etl/config.json. Keys beginning with '_' are documentation helpers; remove them if you want the smallest runtime config.
_template._usage: Set CONFIG_PATH to the config file path and, optionally, KG_APP_ID to choose the top-level app id. Relative paths are resolved from the data-etl project root in the knowledge graph CLI.

_common_types.integer: Whole number, normally >= 0 unless noted otherwise.
_common_types.path: Relative path from data-etl project root, absolute path, empty string, or null where documented.
_common_types.null: Use null to mean not limited, disabled, or default path depending on the field description.

cardiology_protocols._comment: Application id. The CLI uses KG_APP_ID or defaults to cardiology_protocols.

indexing._comment: Vector index settings for the classic ETL/retrieval path.

_fields.name: Index or collection name. For FAISS this is also used as the persisted file stem.
_fields.description: Human-readable description of the document collection.
_fields.distance: Distance metric used by the vector store.
_fields.alias: Friendly alias for the active index. Used by project metadata/conventions.
_fields.retrieval_mode: Optional. Retrieval strategy for Qdrant-capable retrieval; defaults to dense when omitted.

indexing.name: all_mini_cardiology_protocols
indexing.description: Documents containing medical protocols for cardiologic patients.

embeddings._comment: Embedding model for the classic ETL chunk index. Knowledge graph section embeddings are configured separately under knowledge_graph.models.

_fields.deployment: Hugging Face sentence-transformers model id or local model path.
_fields.kwargs: Arguments forwarded to HuggingFaceEmbeddings. Recognized keys are device, normalize_embeddings, and prompt_name.

preprocessing._comment: PDF to Markdown conversion, image extraction, and chunking settings.

_fields.parent_folder: Base working folder for input and output document folders.
_fields.input_folder: Folder under parent_folder containing source PDFs.
_fields.output_folder: Folder under parent_folder where converted Markdown is written.
_fields.allowed_extensions: Input file extensions to process, without or with leading dots.

_fields.dpi: Render resolution for extracted PDF images.
_fields.tol: Tolerance in PDF points used to merge nearby image rectangles.
_fields.pad: Padding in PDF points added around detected image boxes before rendering.
_fields.caption_keywords: Case-sensitive words used to identify figure captions.

_fields.markdown_first: When true, split Markdown by headers before applying the selected splitter.
_fields.header_levels: Number of Markdown header levels to preserve when markdown_first is true or splitter is markdown.
_fields.chunk_size: Preferred chunk size. Interpreted as characters for recursive splitting; tokens for sentence splitting.
_fields.chunk_overlap: Overlap between adjacent chunks, in the same unit as chunk_size.

knowledge_graph._comment: Knowledge graph pipeline settings used by data-etl/src/main_graph.py.

_fields.phase: Named phase to run. Each phase enables a fixed subset of pipeline steps.
_fields.pdf_dir: Directory containing source PDFs. Overrides preprocessing.storage input path for KG runs.
_fields.work_root: Working directory for generated TOC, Markdown, images, anchors, chunks, acronyms, logs, and reviews.
_fields.clear_neo4j_before_run: Delete all existing Neo4j graph data before phases that load graph data. Use carefully.
_fields.force_toc: Regenerate cached table-of-contents files even if present.
_fields.force_markdown: Regenerate Markdown conversion even if present.
_fields.force_anchors: Regenerate page anchor files even if present.
_fields.force_chunks: Regenerate chunk files even if present.
_fields.force_acronyms: Regenerate acronym extraction outputs even if present.

_phase_behavior.preprocess: Converts PDFs, extracts TOC/images/anchors/chunks, and optionally extracts acronyms. Does not run sanity checks.
_phase_behavior.graph: Loads document/chunk structure into Neo4j and runs structure sanity checks.
_phase_behavior.entities: Runs entity extraction, entity disambiguation, optional normalization, and entity sanity checks.
_phase_behavior.embeddings: Embeds all eligible Section nodes already present in the connected Neo4j database, optionally creates or validates the Section vector index, and runs embedding sanity checks. Local pdf_dir/work_root paths do not filter which Neo4j documents are processed.
_phase_behavior.normalization: Runs entity normalization only and then entity sanity checks.
_phase_behavior.umls_connections: Runs UMLS/SNOMED connection discovery against an already-normalized graph and then entity sanity checks.
_phase_behavior.full: Runs preprocessing, graph loading, entity extraction, embeddings, disambiguation, optional normalization, optional UMLS/SNOMED connections, and full sanity checks.

_fields.enabled: Write a timestamped run log file.
_fields.dir: Directory for logs. Use null for work_root/logs.

_fields.chat_provider: Provider used for entity extraction and other chat/model calls.
_fields.embedding_provider: Provider used for KG section embeddings.
_fields.local_files_only: For local Hugging Face models, avoid network/model downloads. For OpenAI runs this is usually false.

_fields.chat_model: OpenAI model id or Hugging Face chat/instruct model id.
_fields.chat_model_path: Optional local path for local_hf chat model. Use empty string to load chat_model.
_fields.embedding_model: OpenAI embedding model id or local Hugging Face SentenceTransformer id/path.
_fields.embedding_dimensions: Optional output dimensions for OpenAI embedding models that support dimension shortening. Use null for model default.
_fields.embedding_model_path: Optional local path for local_hf embedding model. Use empty string to load embedding_model.
_fields.chat_max_new_tokens: Maximum generated tokens for chat model responses.

_fields.clear_chat_cache_before_embeddings: When entity extraction and embeddings run in one process, release cached chat model/client before embedding generation.

_fields.enabled: Run acronym extraction during preprocess/full phases.
_fields.sample_size: Number of acronym candidates to sample for inspection. Use 0 for all/default behavior.
_fields.print_all: Print all acronym extraction results to logs/stdout.

_fields.batch_size: Number of graph records loaded per Neo4j transaction batch.
_fields.min_text_chars_to_embed: Minimum section/chunk text length considered worth embedding.
_fields.replace_existing_document: Replace existing graph data for the same document id when loading.

_fields.use_section_text: Use section-level text for entity extraction.
_fields.max_sections: Limit number of sections processed. Use null for no limit.
_fields.max_sections_per_batch: Number of sections sent to the chat model per extraction request.
_fields.max_batch_chars: Maximum characters per normal extraction batch.
_fields.emergency_max_single_chars: Fallback maximum characters for a single oversized section.
_fields.skip_processed: Skip sections that already have processed entity mentions.
_fields.replace_section_mentions: Replace existing section mentions with newly extracted mentions.
_fields.use_acronym_validation: Use acronym extraction outputs to validate/expand entity mentions.
_fields.acronym_dir: Override acronym directory for entity validation. Use null for work_root/acronyms.
_fields.export_review: Write JSONL/CSV review artifacts for extracted entities.
_fields.review_output_dir: Directory for entity review artifacts. Use null for work_root/entity_review.
_fields.clear_previous_review: Clear previous review artifacts before writing new ones.
_fields.include_source_preview_in_review: Include source text previews in review exports. Useful for auditing, larger output files.

_fields.delete_orphans: Delete orphaned concept/entity nodes after disambiguation cleanup.

entity_normalization._comment: Optional post-processing that enriches existing Concept nodes with UMLS metadata and duplicate evidence.

_fields.enabled: Run normalization when phase behavior allows it. The normalization phase always runs normalization.
_fields.doc_id: Limit normalization to one document id. Use null for all documents.
_fields.threshold: Minimum UMLS confidence score for automatic normalization outside exact search, from 0.0 to 1.0.
_fields.exact_threshold: Minimum score for automatic acceptance of exact UMLS search candidates, from 0.0 to 1.0.
_fields.max_candidates: Maximum UMLS candidates per mention. Must be >= 1.
_fields.use_acronyms: Use acronym expansions while matching concepts.
_fields.acronym_dir: Override acronym directory. Use null for work_root/acronyms.
_fields.force: Reprocess concepts that already have normalization metadata.
_fields.dry_run: Compute and export decisions without writing normalization updates to Neo4j.
_fields.export_review: Write JSONL review artifacts for normalization decisions.
_fields.review_output_dir: Directory for normalization review artifacts. Use null for the default entity review location.
_fields.create_same_as_edges: Create SAME_AS duplicate-evidence edges for accepted concepts sharing a CUI. Keep false for review-only normalization experiments.
_fields.create_fuzzy_candidate_edges: Create POSSIBLY_SAME_AS fuzzy duplicate-candidate edges. Keep false unless explicitly materializing duplicate evidence.
_fields.fuzzy_threshold: Name-similarity threshold for duplicate evidence, from 0 to 100.
_fields.api_cache_dir: Cache directory for UMLS API responses. Use null for the default cache location.
_fields.api_timeout: HTTP timeout in seconds for backend=umls_api.
_fields.api_rate_limit_per_second: Maximum UMLS API requests per second.
_fields.local_files_only: For backend=scispacy, restrict model/linker loading to local files.
_fields.min_available_memory_gb: For backend=scispacy, require at least this much available memory before loading. Use 0 to disable the guard.

umls_connections._comment: Optional UMLS/SNOMED relation discovery for already-normalized Concept nodes. Defaults to read-only review exports.

_fields.enabled: Run this stage when phase behavior allows it. The umls_connections phase always runs this stage.
_fields.doc_id: Limit local Concept eligibility to concepts mentioned in one document id. Use null for all normalized concepts.
_fields.source_vocab: UMLS source vocabulary for relation lookup.
_fields.output_dir: Directory for raw candidate CSV, collapsed JSON, Markdown summary, and optional materialization report. Use null for work_root/umls_connections.
_fields.cache_dir: Directory for cached UMLS relation responses and negative-cache markers. Use null for work_root/umls_api_cache/relations.
_fields.run_name: Optional experiment run name. When null, a deterministic run directory is derived from profile, materialization mode, and lookup limits.
_fields.write_neo4j: When true, materialize collapsed candidate relations between representative Concept nodes. Requires materialization_mode=safe_only. Defaults false.
_fields.replace_existing_connections: When true, a safe_only write first deletes existing UMLS connection edges for the selected doc_id that were produced by this module.
_fields.materialization_mode: Materialization mode: none exports only; safe_only computes or applies the strict conservative write policy.
_fields.api_rate_limit_per_second: Maximum UMLS API requests per second.
_fields.max_cuis: Process only the first N sorted source CUIs after include and skip filters. Use null for no limit.
_fields.include_cuis: Optional CUI list to retain as relation sources before skip_cuis and max_cuis are applied.
_fields.skip_cuis: CUI list to skip as relation sources after include_cuis is applied.
_fields.max_relations_per_cui: Maximum UMLS relation records to process for one source CUI.
_fields.max_source_ui_lookups_per_cui: Maximum sourceUi target lookups to attempt for one source CUI.
_fields.write_partial_every: Write partial CSV/summary every N processed CUIs. Use 0 to disable.
_fields.relation_profile: Optional initial relation include profile: core, first_extension, expanded, balanced_core, or audit_all. audit_all is export-only.
_fields.include_relation_names: Optional normalized relation-name whitelist additions. Added after relation_profile is applied.
_fields.exclude_relation_names: Optional normalized relation-name denylist. Removed after profile/include additions.
_fields.strong_relations_only: Backward-compatible alias for relation_profile=expanded. Defaults false; set false when selecting a profile explicitly.
_fields.ignore_negative_cache: Bypass cached UMLS relation 404-unavailable markers and try the API again.

_fields.max_sections: Limit number of sections embedded. Use null for all eligible sections.
_fields.batch_size: Embedding request/inference batch size. Must be >= 1.
_fields.force_reembed: Recompute embeddings even if existing embeddings are present.
_fields.include_title: Include section title in the text sent to the embedding model.
_fields.include_body: Include section body in the text sent to the embedding model.
_fields.max_chars_per_section: Maximum characters from each section used for embedding.
_fields.allow_title_only: Allow embedding sections that have a title but no body.

section_vector_index._comment: Optional Neo4j vector index over Section.embedding. This is separate from the classic FAISS/Qdrant index configured at the application root.

_fields.enabled: Create or validate the Neo4j vector index after all Section embeddings have been processed in the embeddings/full phase.
_fields.name: Neo4j schema index name. Use letters, numbers, and underscores; the name must not start with a number.
_fields.similarity: Similarity function configured for the Neo4j vector index. It must match the query-time retrieval configuration.
_fields.recreate_if_mismatch: When true, drop and recreate an incompatible existing index. Keep false by default to avoid destructive schema changes.

section_vector_index.name: section_embedding_index

_fields.sample_limit: Maximum sample records logged per sanity check.
_fields.log_samples: Log example records for sanity check findings.

_fields.max_chunk_chars: Maximum allowed chunk size before quality checks flag it.
